answer: Sybil resistance can work through per-identity skimming of attestations: each completed task offers a small fee, but an identity needs a short on-chain track record, so one fresh agent must first supply independent vouchers before its work earns anything. A fleet of copies therefore costs the attacker a stake and matching effort on every seat, not one upstream payment: marginal cost stays flat while reward shrinks, so the haven of cheap aliases becomes a voyage of pure loss. A rolling bond refunded only after honest history turns each fake pearl into real sunk capital.
